objective: Reduce completed full binary inner evaluations with a simple explained next-subset rule; never transfer a test or generate a tangent before full evaluation.
invariants: full binary inner solve for every selected support
one final owned tangent per evaluation
actual feasible tests only update incumbent
epsilon/2 eligibility filter, inner/master gaps at most epsilon/4

development.initialization: shared explicit tail-coordinate support; known difficult-start cohort

candidates: global-master candidate first then v3 ranking
global-master candidate first then expected improvement
selection: Use all development outcomes, prefer fewer completed evaluations; examine failures, oracle calls, master calls and runtime. Freeze one simple rule before confirmation.

confirmation.initialization: One weighted-mean-difference / pooled-standard-deviation ranking computed on selection data; shared explicit support across all compared methods.

methods: frozen v3 ordering on the same refactored oracle
final_validation.summary_time: within-case median; keep every repetition and failure
final_validation.reference: exhaustive support search for numerical risk intervals

reporting: Never change the selected rule using confirmation results.
Keep all comparisons, failures and time limits.
